title: Classification of finite simple groups in Lean
subtitle: A published Lean formalization and an opportunity to audit theorem interfaces and proof dependencies.
target: Specification target: distinguish the indexed classification statement from native classification-and-realization, and record the permitted-axiom checks.
notes: The reported involution-centralizer closure counterexample offers a separate research reading point. It is not an open CFSG classification problem. An experimental Comparator extension exists locally but has not passed Lean or Comparator verification.

title: OpenAI/math: manuscripts and proof artifacts
subtitle: A public repository of mathematical manuscripts with differing levels of formal verification.
target: Specification target: map the exact claims, available Lean files, dependencies, and verification state for each result before proposing reusable proof work.
notes: The repository explicitly notes that not all results have accompanying Lean formalizations. Treat manuscript results and kernel-checked theorems as distinct evidence classes.
